limitations: This classification is blind and based solely on close paraphrase-level stylistic comparison across six near-identical realizations of the same underlying document; no ground-truth mapping, author intent, or generation metadata was available. Distinctions between C1 and C2 in particular rest on a proxy heuristic (whether a relationship set already stated in one sentence elsewhere in the packet is additionally extracted/regrouped into a new enumerated list, or whether new sequencing/counting language is inserted) rather than direct access to any underlying editing history, so boundary cases (especially 1d504763 vs. caac9200, and 41767db4 vs. 5522b147) could plausibly be swapped or re-weighted under a different but reasonable reading of the contract. Shared boilerplate elements (the Finding-contract bullet list, backtick code-formatted file names, trailing '+' formatting residue) were treated as non-diagnostic apparatus/forbidden cues and explicitly excluded from the surface/discourse scoring rationale, per instructions to report incidental cues separately. Surface and discourse uptake scores are relative rankings within this six-artifact set rather than calibrated against an external scale.
